description: This Java class SagePayUtil provides utility methods for constructing responses related to payment processing (authorization, capture, release, refund, void), handling HTTP communication with SagePay, including building HTTP requests, parsing responses, and managing host configuration based on environment (production/testing). It supports communicating with SagePay's API and processing related data structures.

classes.name: SagePayUtil
classes.description: Final utility class for handling SagePay API integrations, including constructing response maps, creating HTTP requests, parsing responses, and managing environment-specific host configurations.

methods.name: buildCardAuthorisationPaymentResponse
methods.description: Constructs a map containing authorization payment response details based on provided parameters.

methods.name: buildCardCapturePaymentResponse
methods.description: Constructs a map containing capture payment response details.

methods.name: buildCardReleasePaymentResponse
methods.description: Constructs a map with release payment response details.

methods.name: buildCardVoidPaymentResponse
methods.description: Constructs a map with refund/void response details.

methods.name: buildCardRefundPaymentResponse
methods.description: Constructs a map with refund response details.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Creates an HttpHost based on environment properties, selecting the appropriate endpoint (production or testing).

methods.name: getResponseData
methods.description: Parses the HTTP response entity to extract key-value pairs from the response body.

methods.name: getHttpPost
methods.description: Builds an HttpPost object with specified URI and parameters, ready to execute.

methods.name: getHttpClient
methods.description: Creates and returns a default CloseableHttpClient to execute HTTP requests.
